requirement.description: The FindInMap class constructor doesn't accept a 'defaultvalue' parameter, causing TypeError when trying to use default values in tests.
requirement.contract: The FindInMap.__init__ method should accept an optional 'defaultvalue' parameter that gets added to the Fn::FindInMap structure as a DefaultValue entry when provided.

requirement.description: The gp3 storage validation incorrectly tries to convert Ref objects to int, causing TypeError when Iops is provided with Ref objects.
requirement.contract: The gp3 storage validation should properly handle AWSHelperFn objects (like Ref) and avoid attempting to convert them to integers.

requirement.description: The DBInstance validation logic doesn't properly enforce mutual exclusivity between MasterUserPassword and ManageMasterUserPassword, and has incorrect error message formatting.
requirement.contract: The DBInstance.validate method should check that MasterUserPassword and ManageMasterUserPassword are mutually exclusive and provide the correct error message format for credential validation.

requirement.description: The Tags class validation doesn't properly handle Tag objects when validating JobDefinition and Table resources, causing TypeError in test_tags.py.
requirement.contract: The Tags.__init__ method should properly handle Tag objects in addition to the existing dict and AWSHelperFn support.
